policies.using:

   FROM ("Organization" o
     JOIN "Certificate" c ON ((c.id = "CertificateDocument"."certificateId")))
  WHERE ((o.id = "CertificateDocument"."organizationId") AND (c.id = "CertificateDocument"."certificateId") AND (c."organizationId" = o.id) AND (o."ownerId" = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))::text) AND (o.status = 'APPROVED'::text)))) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1

  WHERE ((c.id = "CertificateDocument"."certificateId") AND (c."organizationId" = "CertificateDocument"."organizationId") AND (c."graduateId" = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))::text)))) OR (private.is_active_org_staff("organizationId", 'documents:download'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1

   FROM (("CertificateAccessGrant" g
     JOIN "Organization" o ON ((o.id = g."organizationId")))
     JOIN "Certificate" c ON ((c.id = "CertificateDocument"."certificateId")))
  WHERE ((g."certificateId" = "CertificateDocument"."certificateId") AND (c."organizationId" = "CertificateDocument"."organizationId") AND (g.status = 'APPROVED'::text) AND (g."expiresAt" > now()) AND (c.status = 'ACTIVE'::"CertificateStatus") AND (o."ownerId" = (( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))::text) AND (o.status = 'APPROVED'::text) AND private.verity_organization_has_capability(o.id, 'VERIFY_CREDENTIALS'::text)))))
